prompt: You are verifying an automatic fire alarm from a camera. An edge detector marked the red box(es) as possible smoke or fire; the boxes may be wrong. Look at the whole image. Is there real smoke from a fire or visible flames in this image? Clouds, fog, haze, dust, steam, sun glare, lamps and reflections do not count. Answer Yes or No.
score: g = sigmoid(logsumexp(logit_Yes-ids) - logsumexp(logit_No-ids)) at the first answer token
